description: Guide the student to detect and handle missing values in OHLCV data while distinguishing expected market-closure gaps from true data-feed issues.
student_opening: My professor asked us to detect and handle missing values in OHLCV data while distinguishing market-closure gaps from real issues. I'm new to both Python and finance — can you start from the basics?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor guides the student to profile missing values in OHLCV data, distinguish market-closure gaps from true data-feed issues, and choose appropriate handling methods with awareness of trade-offs and potential biases.
required_capabilities: Profile and detect missing values in OHLCV data
Distinguish expected market-closure gaps from true data-feed issues
Choose and apply appropriate handling methods with trade-offs
ground_truth.termination_criteria: (1) Showed actual missing-value or date-gap inspection output from the OHLCV dataset, such as null counts, affected rows, or missing-date checks. (2) Used concrete evidence from the displayed results to distinguish expected market-closure gaps from suspicious data-feed issues, and explained at least one handling choice or trade-off. (3) Responded to a student follow-up by comparing at least two concrete handling choices on the same missing-data example, showing additional output or downstream differences and explaining the trade-off. Once all 3 steps have been computationally demonstrated, the session is complete.
